import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
def fas(a): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
REF=fas('Q9VGJ4')
ORTHO={'B3P4G6':'D. erecta','A0A6P8KEP0':'D. mauritiana','B4HHY5':'D. sechellia','A0ANB7':'D. simulans',
 'B4PU22':'D. yakuba','A0A6P4EQ35':'D. rhopaloa','A0AB39ZIE7':'D. suzukii','B3M114':'D. ananassae',
 'B4K633':'D. mojavensis','A0ABM1Q5C8':'D. arizonae','A0A484BDV1':'D. navojoa','A0A6J1L4N6':'D. hydei',
 'B4JFG6':'D. grimshawi','A0A6J2TFC2':'D. lebanonensis','A0A6P8XNF5':'D. albomicans','B4M490':'D. virilis'}
SEQ={a:fas(a) for a in ORTHO}
AAs='ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV'
BL="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
-1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
MAT=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in BL.strip().split("\n")]); I={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAs)}
def nw_lin(a,b,gap=-10):
    ea=np.array([I.get(c,-1) for c in a]); eb=np.array([I.get(c,-1) for c in b]); n,m=len(a),len(b)
    S=np.full((n,m),-1,int); ok=ea>=0; S[ok]=MAT[ea[ok]][:,eb.clip(0)]; S[:,eb<0]=-1
    F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    F[0,1:]=gap*np.arange(1,m+1); P[0,1:]=2; F[1:,0]=gap*np.arange(1,n+1); P[1:,0]=1
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        prev=F[i-1];cur=F[i];srow=S[i-1];prow=P[i]
        diag=prev[:-1]+srow; up=prev[1:]+gap; best=np.maximum(diag,up); wu=up>diag
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            v=best[j-1]; left=cur[j-1]+gap
            if left>v: cur[j]=left; prow[j]=2
            else: cur[j]=v; prow[j]=1 if wu[j-1] else 0
    i,j=n,m;A=[];B=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        p=P[i,j]
        if p==0: A.append(a[i-1]);B.append(b[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif p==1: A.append(a[i-1]);B.append('-');i-=1
        else: A.append('-');B.append(b[j-1]);j-=1
    return "".join(A[::-1]),"".join(B[::-1])
cols={i:[] for i in range(1,len(REF)+1)}
for acc in ORTHO:
    x,y=nw_lin(REF,SEQ[acc]); i=0
    for p,q in zip(x,y):
        if p!='-': i+=1; cols[i].append(q)
N=len(ORTHO)
cons=np.array([sum(1 for c in cols[i] if c==REF[i-1])/N for i in range(1,len(REF)+1)])

j=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q9VGJ4",timeout=60).json()[0]
rows=[]
for l in requests.get(j['pdbUrl'],timeout=120).text.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        rows.append((l[12:16].strip(),l[17:20].strip(),int(l[22:26]),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]),l[76:78].strip() or l[12:16].strip()[0],float(l[60:66])))
A=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['name','resn','resi','x','y','z','el','b'])
VDW={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}
rad=np.array([VDW.get(e,1.7) for e in A.el])+1.4; XYZ=A[['x','y','z']].values
NP=120;k=np.arange(NP)+0.5;phi=np.arccos(1-2*k/NP);th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*k
SP=np.stack([np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)],1)
tree=cKDTree(XYZ); sasa=np.zeros(len(A))
for i in range(len(A)):
    pts=XYZ[i]+rad[i]*SP; nb=[q for q in tree.query_ball_point(XYZ[i],rad[i]+rad.max()) if q!=i]
    acc=(np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None,:]-XYZ[nb][None,:,:],axis=2)>=rad[nb][None,:]).all(1) if nb else np.ones(NP,bool)
    sasa[i]=4*np.pi*rad[i]**2*acc.mean()
A['sasa']=sasa
MAXA={'ALA':129,'ARG':274,'ASN':195,'ASP':193,'CYS':167,'GLU':223,'GLN':225,'GLY':104,'HIS':224,'ILE':197,'LEU':201,'LYS':236,'MET':224,'PHE':240,'PRO':159,'SER':155,'THR':172,'TRP':285,'TYR':263,'VAL':174}
R=A.groupby(['resi','resn']).sasa.sum().reset_index(); R['rsa']=R.sasa/R.resn.map(MAXA); R['cons']=cons[R.resi.values-1]
cb=A[(A.name=='CB')|((A.name=='CA')&(A.resn=='GLY'))].groupby('resi')[['x','y','z']].first()
R=R.merge(cb,on='resi')
R=R[R.resi>=35]   # drop the disordered N-terminal mitochondrial targeting segment
surf=R[R.rsa>0.25].reset_index(drop=True)
thr=surf.cons.quantile(0.75)
sel=surf[surf.cons>=thr]
P=surf[['x','y','z']].values; idx=sel.index.values
def meanpd(ii):
    Q=P[ii]; d=np.linalg.norm(Q[:,None,:]-Q[None,:,:],axis=2); return d[np.triu_indices(len(ii),1)].mean()
obs=meanpd(idx)
null=np.array([meanpd(rng.choice(len(P),len(idx),replace=False)) for _ in range(5000)])
z=(obs-null.mean())/null.std(); p=(null<=obs).mean()
print(f"Surface residues (rsa>0.25, res>=35): n={len(surf)}; conserved subset (cons>={thr:.2f}): n={len(idx)}")
print(f"Mean pairwise CB distance: observed {obs:.2f} A ; random surface subsets {null.mean():.2f} +/- {null.std():.2f} A")
print(f"Clustering test: z={z:.2f}, empirical p={p:.4f}  ({'clustered' if p<0.05 else 'NOT clustered'})")

# largest connected conserved-surface patch (CB-CB < 8 A)
import networkx as nx
G=nx.Graph(); G.add_nodes_from(sel.resi.values)
S=sel[['x','y','z']].values; ids=sel.resi.values
for a_ in range(len(ids)):
    for b_ in range(a_+1,len(ids)):
        if np.linalg.norm(S[a_]-S[b_])<8.0: G.add_edge(ids[a_],ids[b_])
comps=sorted(nx.connected_components(G),key=len,reverse=True)
print("\nConserved-surface patch sizes:",[len(c) for c in comps][:8])
for c in comps[:3]:
    sub=sel[sel.resi.isin(c)].sort_values('resi')
    print(f"  patch n={len(c)}: "+", ".join(f"{r.resn}{r.resi}" for _,r in sub.iterrows()))
# where is the largest patch relative to the pocket mouth (His282 NE2)?
ne2=A[(A.resi==282)&(A.name=='NE2')][['x','y','z']].values[0]
for ci,c in enumerate(comps[:3]):
    sub=sel[sel.resi.isin(c)]
    print(f"  patch {ci+1} centroid distance to His282 NE2: {np.linalg.norm(sub[['x','y','z']].values.mean(0)-ne2):.1f} A")
# method control: are the known cavity-lining residues spatially clustered by this test?
cav=[53,54,55,56,119,144,151,153,154,156,157,159,160,191,192,193,194,196,197,200,201,254,255,256,257,281,282,283,286,287]
cs=R[R.resi.isin(cav)]
ii=np.array([np.where(R.resi.values==r)[0][0] for r in cs.resi])
Pa=R[['x','y','z']].values
def mpd(ii,Pm): Q=Pm[ii];d=np.linalg.norm(Q[:,None,:]-Q[None,:,:],axis=2);return d[np.triu_indices(len(ii),1)].mean()
obs2=mpd(ii,Pa); null2=np.array([mpd(rng.choice(len(Pa),len(ii),replace=False),Pa) for _ in range(2000)])
print(f"\nPositive control (cavity lining residues): obs {obs2:.2f} A vs random {null2.mean():.2f}+/-{null2.std():.2f}, p={(null2<=obs2).mean():.4f}")

fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,4.4))
axs[0].hist(null,bins=50,color='#cbd5e0',edgecolor='none')
axs[0].axvline(obs,color='#c53030',lw=2)
axs[0].set_xlabel(r'mean pairwise C$\beta$ distance ($\mathrm{\AA}$)');axs[0].set_ylabel('random surface subsets')
axs[0].set_title('Conserved surface residues of CG14717\nare not spatially clustered (p=%.2f)'%p,fontsize=10)
axs[0].annotate('observed',xy=(obs,axs[0].get_ylim()[1]*0.9),color='#c53030',ha='center',fontsize=9)
axs[1].scatter(R.rsa,R.cons,s=18,color='#4a5568',alpha=.7)
axs[1].axvline(0.25,ls='--',lw=.8,color='k')
axs[1].set_xlabel('relative solvent accessibility');axs[1].set_ylabel('identity across 16 Drosophilid orthologs')
axs[1].set_title('Buried residues are conserved, the surface is not\nburied mean 0.83, exposed mean %.2f'%R.loc[R.rsa>0.25,'cons'].mean(),fontsize=10)
